tv-tt2145118.s: The series revolves around the family of Haji Abdul Sattar, who is a drug dealer and is assisted by his eldest son without the knowledge of his family. When Abdul Sattar dies, his sons know the truth from their elder brother, and they decide to complete a drug deal so as not to lose their money.

mv-tt28296772.s: Kupu-Kupu Kertas (English: Paper Butterfly) is a 2024 Indonesian drama film wrapped in history that premiered in Indonesian cinemas on February 7, 2024. The film was withdrawn from circulation on February 10, 2024, then the film was re-screened on September 26, 2024.

mv-tt0048489.s: The Letters Page (Italian: Piccola posta) is a 1955 Italian comedy film directed by Steno, starring Alberto Sordi. Actually the film's full title is Piccola posta ovvero: cercasi vecchia con dote (translation: "The Letters Page, or Searching for a Rich Older Woman").

tv-tt0155658.s: Denji Sentai Megaranger (電磁戦隊メガレンジャー, Denji Sentai Megarenjā; Electromagnetic Squadron Megaranger) is Toei's twenty-first production of the Super Sentai metaseries, and the second Sentai, after Kousoku Sentai Turboranger in which all heroes are high school students.

mv-tt0156014.s: Red Rose is a 1980 Indian Hindi-language psychological thriller film, starring Rajesh Khanna and Poonam Dhillon. It is a remake of the Tamil film Sigappu Rojakkal, made by the same director Bharathi Rajaa and the same cinematographer P. S. Nivas. The film was a box office failure.

mv-tt0173240.s: Among Grey Stones is a 1983 Soviet historical drama film directed by Kira Muratova. The film suffered a lot from the Soviet censorship and was edited without the acceptance of Muratova, so she refused to release it under her name - it was attributed to "Ivan Sidorov" (a common Russian name and surname).

mv-tt0206867.s: Little Ilker is a real trouble maker. He regularly prank calls the police, the fire department and plays tricks on anyone he encounters. One evening, while snooping around, Ilker witnesses a vicious murder and immediately runs to tell about it. There's only one problem...no one believes him!

mv-tt0400522.s: Håkan Bråkan & Josef is a Swedish comedy film which was released to cinemas in Sweden on 8 October 2004, directed by Erik Leijonborg and based on Anders Jacobsson and Sören Olsson's stories about Håkan, a Sune spinoff character.

tv-tt15361062.s: Rahti (Cargo), is a Finnish eight-part crime drama television miniseries, which was broadcast on Yle TV1 from 3 September 2021. The series is based on an idea by Matti Kinnunen, who is also the director and a scriptwriter. It was co-written by Veikko Aaltonen and Johanna Hartikainen.

mv-tt4041170.s: In Silver Lake, Los Angeles, Cal learns that Thom, his boyfriend of four years, has been cheating on him with Jeremy. Though upset, Cal decides that he does not want to end the relationship.

mv-tt5428666.s: FP2: Beats of Rage is a 2018 American comedy film and the sequel to the 2011 film The FP. Written, produced, and directed by Jason Trost, the film focuses on JTRO (Trost) and KCDC (Art Hsu), former members of the 248 gang, traveling through the Wastes to participate in the Beats of Rage tournament.

mv-tt6241390.d: Anna Chi, Daniel Chuba, Mark A.Z. Dippé
mv-tt6241390.s: The Boxcar Children: Surprise Island is a 2018 American animated adventure film featuring the voices of Joey King, Talitha Bateman, Griffin Gluck, Carter Sand, Gil Birmingham, Stephen Stanton, Dane DeHaan, J. K. Simmons and Martin Sheen. It is the sequel of the 2014 film The Boxcar Children.

mv-tt0047895.s: The Boys from Leningrad is a 1954 Soviet sports comedy film directed by Semyon Timoshenko. The film tells the story of a promising young footballer who steps up to save his team both on the field and in goal, while navigating romantic rivalry and unexpected challenges on a journey to the Trade Unions Cup final.

tv-tt0291343.s: The planet Zion is mankind's last hope for survival. But the legions of Victim are intent on destroying humanity! Five humanoid fighting weapons called Ingrids are capable of stopping the onslaught, but only the best pilots are chosen to become Pilot Candidates. The fate of Zion rests with these chosen few.

mv-tt32063216.s: Liberato's Secret (Italian: Il segreto di Liberato) is a 2024 Italian adult animated documentary film directed by Giorgio Testi, Francesco Lettieri, Giuseppe Squillaci and Lorenzo Ceccotti (a.k.a. LRNZ). The film tells the evolution of Italian singer Liberato, who also scores the soundtrack.

mv-tt0015973.s: Kentucky Pride is a 1925 American silent drama film from Fox Film about the life of a horse breeder and racer, directed by the famed film director John Ford and starring Henry B. Walthall (who had previously played the Little Colonel in D. W. Griffith's controversial 1915 film The Birth of a Nation).

mv-tt0027754.s: The Court Concert (German: Das Hofkonzert) is a 1936 German historical romantic comedy film directed by Detlef Sierck (later known as Douglas Sirk), and starring Mártha Eggerth, Johannes Heesters, and Kurt Meisel. It was made by the largest German studio UFA, based on Das kleine Hofkonzert.

mv-tt0036026.s: I Escaped from the Gestapo is a 1943 film from King Brothers Productions, directed by Harold Young about a forger forced to work for Nazi spies. It stars Dean Jagger, Mary Brian and John Carradine.

mv-tt0077573.s: The Foreigner is a 1978 American independent no wave film directed by Amos Poe starring Eric Mitchell with semi-improvised appearances by Patti Astor, Anya Phillips and Debbie Harry.

mv-tt1129404.s: Another Harvest Moon is a 2009 American drama film written by Jeremy T. Black and directed by Greg Swartz and starring Ernest Borgnine, Piper Laurie, Anne Meara, and Doris Roberts. The plot is about four elderly citizens coping with life in a nursing home.

mv-tt1459998.s: Ji-ho is a writer who cannot forget her first love Min-woo at high school. She meets Min-woo and acts as if she lost her memories to grab his attention. As she lives with him, Dong-sik comes along and annoys her plans.

mv-tt8798274.s: After a student starts his college education abroad, a new friendship creates distance between him and his concerned girlfriend back home.
